name: Overflow
overview: Scripture reveals that overflow is a divine blessing reflecting God's abundant provision and protection. The psalmist describes a cup that 'runneth over,' symbolizing God's generosity even amid adversity, while Proverbs emphasizes overflowing abundance as a result of faithful stewardship. Isaiah assures believers that trials will not overwhelm them, illustrating God's sustaining presence through life's floods and fires. Furthermore, Luke highlights that the overflow of the heart shapes our words and actions, underscoring the spiritual significance of what fills us inwardly.
